_comment: Building prefabs assembled from the Quaternius Medieval Village MegaKit (3D/environments/quaternius-medieval-village-standard). Each building type is one or more blocks on a 2 m grid. block: cells [x, z] (2 m each), at [x, z] = block center in meters (building center is 0,0; the door side is +Z), stories (3 m each), walls (plaster | brick), ground (wall set for the ground story, optional), roof (tiles | thatch | thatch_worn | tower | none), ridge (x | z), door (true on the block that holds the front door). 'variants' picks how many distinct looks a type can have; the building's variant number chooses one. Missing kit categories are listed in 'missing' so they show up in docs and logs instead of being silently replaced.
_home_tiers: Upgraded homes (Phase 3): the door block gains stories over the same ground floor. Index = home tier (data/territory.json homes.tiers). A tier can re-roof the door block (roof) and mend a poor home (repairs: wall patches, shutters: plank or the kit's): a Cottage's weathered thatch becomes neat thatch at a Timber House and tiles at a Townhouse.
_roots: Folders of the game's own building pieces: a module named 'family:NAME' loads <root>NAME.glb.
_thatch: Thatch & Repair (3D/buildings/thatch-repair). roofs: a block's roof 'thatch' (neat, block-cut ridge) or 'thatch_worn' (a poor home's) by span x length, hipped so it takes no gables; a size the family lacks falls back to tiles. A recipe's 'repairs' patches up to that many ground-floor walls (patch_chance each plain wall, the front first; a home's patches go down the wall set's list in order, so they differ; patch_height m up, patch_offset m out from the wall's line), and 'shutters': 'plank' hangs plank shutters (one leaf hanging, a board gone) in place of the kit's.

missing.mill: No windmill in the village kit: the tower is kit-built, the sails are simple boards using the kit's wood texture. Needs a windmill model (Ultimate Fantasy RTS or custom).
missing.bakery: No bread oven. Needs Fantasy Props MegaKit or custom prop.
missing.barracks: No crenellations, weapon racks or training dummies. Needs a castle/military kit in the Quaternius style.
missing.tavern: No hanging sign, tables or barrels. Needs Fantasy Props MegaKit.
missing.chapel: No church/temple pieces (bell, stained glass, altar). Built from village walls + tower roof.
